case_number: 2025 INSC 402; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.14900 of 2024)
summary: FIR quashing under Section 482 Cr.P.C. challenged; allegations under Section 306 IPC require proximate link between instigation and suicide; one-month gap dissolves nexus; death note discovered postmortem; delay in complaint reporting raises afterthought concerns; High Court's mini-trial critique; investigation material cited; proximate cause standard reinforced; impugned judgment upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.306, s.420, s.506, s.34
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.174, s.482
Prakash and Others v. State of Maharashtra and Another
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment upholding quashing of FIR sustained.
